name: uwp-ai-forge
description: Turn a date window into a release-post changelog for WordPress Core + Gutenberg, right inside Claude Desktop.
long_description: UnleashWP AI Forge is a hub for WordPress release tooling. This bundle registers AI Forge as an MCP server so Claude can call its tools live — get_changelog, list_milestones, list_branches, show_changelog — and open the full AI Forge app as a window. A logged-in WordPress.org session is required: without it, WordPress.org Trac serves a bot wall and contributor and Core ticket counts come back inaccurate. An optional GitHub token raises the API limit from 60 to 5,000 requests/hour.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Raises the GitHub API limit from 60 to 5,000 requests/hour. No scopes needed — AI Forge only reads public repos. Leave empty to run at 60/hour.

trac_cookie.title: WordPress.org login cookie (required)
trac_cookie.description: Required. Without a logged-in WordPress.org session, Trac serves its bot wall instead of data and contributor + Core ticket counts come back inaccurate. Paste 'wporg_logged_in=…; wporg_sec=…' from a logged-in wordpress.org session. Stored by Claude Desktop; sent only to WordPress.org.
